# Attend.™

Attend.™ is a privacy-focused, local-first college attendance tracker for custom semesters, subjects, timetable sessions, holidays, exams, and events. No data is collected and nothing leaves the visitor's device; all processing happens locally in the browser.

## Public pages
- /home — Entry splash for the Attend.™ tracker
- / — Month calendar and per-session attendance marking
- /today — Today's sessions
- /week — Weekly session view
- /list — Date-range session list
- /subjects — Subject attendance summaries
- /events — Events and holidays
- /reports — Attendance reports and target forecasts
- /semester — Semester, subject, and timetable setup
- /about — Calculation methods, data handling, and limitations
- /terms — Terms of service, trademark and intellectual property notice

Attendance records are user-entered and stored locally in the visitor's browser. Calculation rules are documented at /about.
